caption: The drawing depicts a metallic coffee pot or teapot with a conical body that widens toward the base and narrows toward the top. The pot has a long, straight spout positioned on the left side and a large, ornate handle on the right side, which is curved and appears to be made from a darker material. The lid is circular and slightly domed, topped with a decorative finial. The surface of the pot is smooth with a reflective metallic sheen, rendered in shades of grey, suggesting a metal like silver or pewter. The base and the lid both feature subtle horizontal ridges for decoration. The background of the drawing is a plain light beige or off-white color, and there are no other objects or decorations present.
title: Silver Coffee Pot
